blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Police arrested Eastern Visayas’ top regional anti-drug priority target and his alleged cohort in a buy-bust operation in Tolosa, Leyte, on Monday, recovering about 117 grams of suspected shabu valued at P795,600. Personnel of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit 8 (RPDEU-8) and the Tolosa Municipal Police Station conducted the operation in Barangay San Roque. Police identified the main suspect as alias “Ton-ton,” 32, whom they described as a high-value individual and Rank 1 on the Regional Priority Target List. His alleged cohort, alias “Beng,” 31, was also arrested. Both are residents of Tolosa. READ: P40.8-M shabu, guns seized; […]...
